say:3:1311127001:1.text: Welcome, guests! Please make yourselves comfortable. Would you care for a cup of tea? I can brew a fresh cup right from my head!
say:3:1311127001:1.source_cn: 客人们，请坐，想要喝一杯茶吗？我可以用我的脑袋为您沏一...

say:5:1311127003:1.text: Yes, please! Chippy would love to sip on some tea!

say:7:1311127004:1.text: Mister Teapot, how long have you been serving in this, um, manor—if you can call it that?
say:7:1311127004:1.source_cn: 茶壶先生，你在这个废墟……呃，庄园中，服务多久了？

say:8:1311127005:1.text: Please hold onto your cup carefully, it might be hot. Well, I've been serving His Lordship for as long as I can remember! Hmm, was it fifty years? Seventy? It's all a blur now...
say:8:1311127005:1.source_cn: 这就对了，客人请拿好杯子，小心烫。我从记事起就在为子爵...

say:9:1311127006:1.text: He is a truly noble and kind gentleman. Alas, there's no one in the Valesa family quite as graceful and talented as His Lordship.
say:9:1311127006:1.source_cn: 他是位高贵的、温柔的好先生。唉，瓦勒沙家族再没人能比子...

say:11:1311127007:1.text: I recall how he loved to bask in the afternoon sun, sipping tea while reading "Helm of the Shadowed Knight".
say:11:1311127007:1.source_cn: 记得那时候，子爵先生最喜欢沐浴在午后的阳光下，一边喝茶...

say:12:1311127008:1.text: He always dreamed of charging into battle like the protagonist, Zavros... Unfortunately, His Lordship was frail as a child...
say:12:1311127008:1.source_cn: 他一直梦想着能像小说主角扎维沙那样驰骋沙场……可惜，子...

say:13:1311127009:1.text: However, it brings me joy that he has attained immortality. My service to His Lordship shall endure for eternity!
say:13:1311127009:1.source_cn: 但令人欣喜的是，他成为了不朽之躯。我对子爵先生的侍奉也...

say:14:1311127010:1.text: Chippy is touched! You really like Ludovic!
say:14:1311127010:1.source_cn: 看来你很喜欢柳博米尔呀！

say:15:1311127011:1.text: Of course! I've always been by his side, and I take pride in being his favorite teapot! I would be honored to serve His Lordship forever.
say:15:1311127011:1.source_cn: 当然！我是从他小时候就开始陪伴他的、他最喜爱的茶壶！如...
